text: All of the voting stock of Minnesota Life Insurance Company is owned by Securian Financial Group, Inc., which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Securian Holding Company, whose ultimate parent is Minnesota Mutual Companies, Inc.

source.name: Securian Funds Trust: Definitive Information Statement (DEF 14C), SEC EDGAR
source.quote: Securian Financial Group, Inc., which in turn is a wholly-owned subsidiary of a first tier intermediate stock holding company named Securian Holding Company, which in turn is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the ultimate parent, Minnesota Mutual Companies, Inc.
